author: (Krøyer, 1868)

note.en: A slender barracudina of the open ocean; known here only as a regional record.
note.es: Una barracudina delgada del océano abierto; aquí solo se conoce como registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
recWhy: Oceanic fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Long slim silvery body with a duck-bill-like snout and sharp teeth.
marks.es: Cuerpo largo, delgado y plateado, con un hocico en forma de pico de pato y dientes afilados.
